title: 一道菜带火一座城④完结·荣昌卤鹅：五一卖爆752%，火遍32国 | One Dish One Town P4 · Rongchang 🦢
description:
沙县、淄博、天水、荣昌——四座城，你站哪一座？评论区说说。

【一道菜带火一座城·完结篇 荣昌卤鹅】2025年春天，重庆荣昌靠一只卤鹅火遍全球。一位49岁大叔、人称"卤鹅哥"，追着一位国际网红投喂卤鹅，单条视频播放破1.2亿、传到32个国家。荣昌卤鹅是客家与巴蜀交融的非遗美食，有300多年历史。那个五一，234.5万游客涌进荣昌，29万只卤鹅抢购一空，销量暴涨752.53%。

四集看下来，你会发现一件事：沙县用了几十年，淄博用了一个五一，天水用了一条视频，荣昌只用了一个人——一座城被一道菜带火，越来越快。但正如人民网一年后回访所说，出圈容易、留住才难，接得住流量才是真本事。

Finale · Rongchang. In spring 2025 one braised goose put this Chongqing county on the world map. A 49-year-old locals call "Goose Bro" chased a global influencer offering goose; the clip hit 120M views across 32 countries. Rongchang's braise is 300-year-old Hakka heritage. That May holiday, 2.34M visitors came, 290,000 geese sold out, sales up 752.53%. Across four episodes the pattern is clear — Shaxian took decades, Zibo a holiday, Tianshui a video, Rongchang one person. Going viral keeps getting faster; staying, as a year-later revisit noted, is the hard part.

AI-assisted edit; the bilingual subtitles are the narration — no voiceover. Facts checked this run; sources below. Food & travel note, not investment advice. Footage licensed from Pexels (credited below).
